steps.description:
In Pokemon game, each Pokemon type can have a different number of evolution. For example, Eevee can evolve into Umbreon while Charmander can evolve into Charmeleon and Charizard.

Create a program to store Pokemon types with their evolution. Your program starts by letting the user choose from a menu: [1] Add [2] Display all

For [1], the program will ask the user to enter the number of the evolution of a Pokemon type followed by the name of each Pokemon (e.g. there are 3 evolution for Pichu and the names are Pichu, Pikachu, Raichu). The record will be appended to the file data.txt.

For [2], the program will read data.txt and display all the pokemons with a blank line after each group of evolution.

The program will return to the menu after each operation.

You can decide the format of your file contents but you should not read the entire file content into a list (assuming the data can be huge). You must create at least one function for each menu task.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.

Hint: - You can read one evolution group at a time into a list while reading the data file but you should not store the entire file data into a list.

Test Input

1 2 Eevee Umbreon 2 1 1 Mimikyu 1 3 Charmander Charmeleon Charizard 2

Test Output (Red Text - User Input)

Test your program with the example below: [1] Add [2] Display all Enter selection: 1 Enter number of pokemon in evolution: 2 Type 1: Eevee Type 2: Umbreon

[1] Add [2] Display all Enter selection: 2 Eevee Umbreon

[1] Add [2] Display all Enter selection: 1 Enter number of pokemon in evolution: 1 Type 1: Mimikyu

[1] Add [2] Display all Enter selection: 1 Enter number of pokemon in evolution: 3 Type 1: Charmander Type 2: Charmeleon Type 3: Charizard

[1] Add [2] Display all
Enter selection: 2

Create a program to store records of Pokemon evolution. Your program starts by letting user choose from a menu: [1] Add [2] Search [3] Display all

For [1], the program will ask the user to enter the number of evolution of a Pokemon type followed by the name of each Pokemon (e.g. there 3 evolution for Pichu and the names are Pichu, Pikachu, Raichu). The record will be appended to the file data.txt.

For [2], the program will ask the user to input a pokemon name. It will search data.txt for an exact match. If found, it will display the names of all the Pokemon in the evolution group. Otherwise, it will display "Pokemon not found".

For [3], the program will read data.txt and display all the pokemons with a blank line after each group of evolution.

The program will return to the menu after each operation.

You can decide the format of your file contents but you must create at least one function for each menu task.

Follow the test output display format and comment your codes.
